summary: Frontend-only testing of the UI/UX polish pass for 'Now Kart'. Verified the AnimatedPressable refactor (Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Pressable)) holds correctly everywhere - CustomTabBar renders 3 evenly-spaced tabs (125px each, flex:1 intact), Button, IconButton, ProductCard (+wishlist/add sub-buttons), CategoryCard, QuantityStepper, SearchBar, and back buttons all tap correctly with no layout collapse. Tested via Playwright on mobile viewport (375x667) against the public preview URL. Home skeleton->content transition, Categories skeleton->grid, hero 'Start shopping'->Categories tab nav, product card independent tap zones (card/wishlist/add), header badges (0->1 on wishlist/cart), QuantityStepper min-1 floor + live price label update, Search screen (loading spinner, matching/non-matching results, EmptyState), Orders empty state, and Orders/Categories/Home tab switching all work correctly. Header icon buttons measured exactly 44x44px. No console errors or React Native red-screen crashes found in any flow. Confirmed 100% placeholder data - no backend/API calls anywhere.

ui_bugs.issue: The banner's outer Animated.View has pointerEvents='box-none' (correctly lets taps pass through empty space), but its LinearGradient child container does NOT set pointerEvents, so its own bounding rectangle (a horizontal strip near the bottom, positioned absolutely over the ScrollView content) intercepts taps on any product card/button that happens to render underneath it. Reproduced: tapping a product card title that was visually covered by the banner did NOT navigate (click landed on the banner strip instead); dismissing the banner first (or scrolling so the card is not underneath) made the exact same tap work correctly and navigate to product detail. This creates a real dead-zone over the last visible row of the 'Best sellers in Beverages' rail (and any other content the banner floats over) whenever the banner is showing.

action_items: Fix FreeDeliveryBanner dead-zone: the LinearGradient/container inside the banner (not just the outer wrapper) should be limited to only its visible pill area, OR reduce the wrapper's absolute-positioned hit area to match only the visible pill (it currently seems fine visually, but functionally the whole horizontal band at that vertical offset intercepts taps - suggest testing with a fixed-width container matched exactly to the pill's rendered bounds, or verify z-index/hitbox isn't larger than the rendered gradient). Simplest fix: confirm the LinearGradient container's actual layout width matches the visible pill (with left/right margins) and not the full flex width of an invisible parent.
Retest ProductRail items that render directly under the floating FreeDeliveryBanner position after the fix to confirm taps pass through correctly without needing to dismiss the banner first.
critical_code_review_comments: AnimatedPressable fix (Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Pressable) as single element receiving both layout style and animated transform) is correctly implemented and verified across CustomTabBar, Button, ProductCard, CategoryCard, QuantityStepper, SearchBar, and back buttons - no flex/layout collapse found anywhere.

CustomTabBar is well-built with explicit testIDs, active indicator, and correct outline/filled icon swap - resolves the MEDIUM issue flagged in iteration_1 report (tabBarTestID not propagating to DOM) since a fully custom tab bar renderer with explicit testID is now used.
useMockLoading + Skeleton components integrate cleanly into Home/Categories screens without causing flicker or stuck-loading states.
No backend/API calls detected anywhere - consistent with stated pure-UI-polish scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only one real bug found this iteration: FreeDeliveryBanner overlay creates a tap dead-zone over content behind it (see ui_bugs). All other polish features (animations, skeletons, tab bar fix, AnimatedPressable everywhere) verified working correctly with no layout regressions and no console errors. After the banner fix, just re-verify a product card that renders directly under the banner's floating position is tappable WITHOUT first dismissing the banner.
rca_of_issue: FreeDeliveryBanner wrapper (Animated.View) sets pointerEvents='box-none' which correctly makes the wrapper transparent to touches in its own empty space, but this setting is NOT inherited by children on web - the child LinearGradient view (which visually renders as a smaller centered pill via left/right spacing.lg margins) still has default pointerEvents='auto' and captures any click within its actual layout bounding box. Since this pill sits absolutely positioned near the bottom of the screen over the ScrollView's last visible content (e.g. bottom row of the Beverages rail), clicks in that exact area resolve to the banner element (topmost in z-order) rather than the underlying Pressable, even though the pill itself is not covering the full width in most cases the browser hit-test still picked the banner for the tested tap position. Fix should ensure the interactive gradient's hitbox does not extend over rail content unintentionally, or move the banner higher / verify insets.bottom + spacing calc keeps it clear of the last product row on shorter screens.
